process_type: plasma enhanced ALD (PE-ALD) and thermal ALD
summary: The study compares thermal and plasma enhanced atomic layer deposition (ALD) of Co using Co(iPr-Me-AMD)2 as a precursor and H2 molecules for thermal ALD and NH3 plasma for PE-ALD. It focuses on growth characteristics, film properties, and area selectivity using self-assembled monolayers (SAMs).
evidence: In this study, we investigated the growth characteristics and film properties of thermal and PE-ALD using Co(iPr-Me-AMD)2 as a Co precursor and H2 molecules and NH3 plasma as a reactant for thermal and PE-ALD, respectively.
